claims.text: Wet AMD: intravitreal anti-VEGF (usually ranibizumab, bevacizumab or aflibercept) substantially reduces the risk of vision loss; a refillable implanted port can deliver ranibizumab continuously
claims.quote: Intravitreal injection of antivascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) medications (usually ranibizumab, bevacizumab, or aflibercept) can substantially reduce the risk of vision loss and can preserve useful vision in 20% of patients over their lifetime and reading vision in at least one eye in 15% (8). An implantable port delivery system for ranibizumab is available for the treatment of wet AMD (9). This is a surgically placed permanent refillable ocular implant that continuously delivers ranibizumab into the vitreous
